_comment: Per-clip metadata. Key = baked clip name (FBX file stem, or 'file:take'). Keys: name (alias used by anim sets), loop, speed, root_speed (m/s travel of an in-place clip: speed matching; measured with tools/bake_anim --survey), root_motion, markers [left_plant, right_plant], events, blend_in, blend_out, additive, reference, yaw (degrees about +Y, negative = to the right: the hips / legs turn, the upper body keeps its pose), air_in_place (a jump: the hips never rise above their stance height, the rise comes from the movement). Clips play in their authored facing (Mixamo forward = the game's forward): no yaw needed for them.
